english.quote: For students enrolled in the 2024–2025 Academic Year and thereafter, the minimum TOEFL iBT score required for external exam emption is: Examinations Taken Before January 21, 2026: 85 (old system) / 4.5 (new system) Examinations Taken After January 21, 2026: 4.5
english.how_found: Search (site:sabanciuniv.edu) 'Sabancı University international undergraduate admissions requirements English proficiency TOEFL IELTS' -> result 'Exemption from FDY' (School of Languages page on the main domain). IELTS statement: same search -> result 'English Language Requirements' FAQ on iro.sabanciuniv.edu.
english.notes: Direct entry = exemption from the Foundation Development Year (FDY, English preparatory programme). Table on the page (exam | validity | minimum): 'PTE Academic | 2 years | 71 (Minimum score should be 67 from each part)'; 'TOEFL IBT | 2 years | 85 - 4,5* (MyBest scores are not accepted)'; 'CAE | 3 years | C'; 'CPE | 3 years | C'; 'YDS | 5 years | 90'; 'ELAE Stage 2 (Sabanci University's own Proficiency Exam) | 2 years | 70'. For an autumn-2027 entrant any TOEFL iBT taken after 21 Jan 2026 is on the new 1–6 band scale, so the operative TOEFL minimum is 4.5 (85 is the old 0–120 scale). The quote spans three consecutive lines on the page, joined here with single spaces. IELTS is NOT accepted: FAQ https://iro.sabanciuniv.edu/en/degree-students/frequently-asked-questions/english-language-requirements says verbatim 'No, IELTS is not accepted in Turkey. This is a decision taken by the YOK (Council of Higher Education), binding for all Turkish universities.' Also on the FDY page: 'The "home edition” and “online versions" of the external exams are not accepted for exemption from the Foundation Development Year for undergraduate level students.' English proficiency is not required at application; FAQ: 'Yes, you can provide us your TOEFL until the registration week to be exempt from English Language School.' Students without an accepted score sit the ELAE in orientation week and, if unsuccessful, enter the English preparatory programme.

value.description: Published minimum for the applicant's credential type: the Attestat / General Secondary Education Certificate (Kazakhstan is listed) requires a minimum average of 70% diploma score; the alternative Kazakhstan entry is 'Kazakhstan National Test / Unified National Testing(ENT UNT) | A minimum score of 100 out of 140'. International exams also accepted: SAT 'A minimum grade of 1100 out of 1600', ACT 'A minimum score of 23 out of 36 in Composite', IB 'A minimum diploma score of 28 out of 45'. One accepted exam/diploma with a valid score is mandatory for the application to be evaluated; SAT is not mandatory.

gpa.quote: Attestat / General Secondary Education Certificate / Shahodatnoma (Azerbaijan, Ukraine, Moldova, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Georgia, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Mongolia, Russia) | A minimum average of 70% diploma score*
gpa.how_found: Application Requirements page (https://iro.sabanciuniv.edu/en/application-requirements) -> section 'Acceptable Exams/Diplomas' ('Candidates should submit one of the exams/diplomas with valid score accepted by the University') -> search (site:sabanciuniv.edu) 'Sabancı University international students accepted exams diplomas minimum scores SAT ACT IB undergraduate application' -> result 'Required Exam/Diploma List'.
gpa.notes: The quote is two adjacent table cells (credential | minimum), separated here by ' | '. Footnote on the page: '*Percentage value is determined by dividing the sum total of grades on the diploma/exam result by the number of courses the student has taken. The final ratio should meet the minimum requirement.' Also: 'Applicants, whose cumulative grade point average (CGPA) is not stated on their final diploma/transcript, are required submit a letter from their high school administration to declare their graduation cumulative grade point average.' and 'Please note that SAT is not mandatory.' The exam/diploma list page carries no academic-year label (the undated current list; an older '2024-2025' version exists at iro.sabanciuniv.edu/en/required-examdiploma-list-2024-2025). Admission is competitive within quotas (Application Requirements page: 160 places for Engineering and Natural Sciences programmes for 2026-2027), so the minimum is a threshold for evaluation, not an admission guarantee.

deadline.how_found: Search (site:sabanciuniv.edu) 'Sabancı University international students scholarship undergraduate admission' -> result 'How to Apply' (iro.sabanciuniv.edu) -> section 'Key Dates and Deadlines'. Corroborated on https://iro.sabanciuniv.edu/en/application-requirements ('Application Dates' section).
deadline.notes: ONLY THE 2026 CYCLE (2026-2027 academic year, autumn 2026 entry) IS PUBLISHED as of 2026-10-17; no 2027-2028 undergraduate application conditions page exists yet (targeted search found none). Round name: 'Application Deadline' — the final closing date of the single rolling application period; the same page lists '• Early Application Deadline: March 14, 2026' and '• Start of Application Period: January 1st, 2026'. The Application Requirements page states the window as 'December 15, 2025-August 28, 2026 (Online application form will be closed at 16:00 Turkish time.)' — the two official pages disagree on the opening date (15 Dec 2025 vs 1 Jan 2026) but agree on the 28 Aug 2026 close. Applications are evaluated on a rolling basis (Application Requirements page: applicants notified by email within 2-3 weeks) and 'Early applicants receive priority consideration by the Scholarship Committee.' Expect the 2027 cycle to follow a similar pattern (open mid-December 2026/January 2027, close late August 2027), but this is not published.

tuition.notes: 2027/28 fees are not published as of 2026-10-17; the latest published is the 2026-2027 figure (quote joins the section heading and the two table cells). Dormitory fees are separate ('Dormitory fees are calculated as a 9-month total per person'). How-to-apply page: offer email includes 'A deadline and bank details for the pre-payment amount (2000 USD)', non-refundable, deducted from tuition. Application fee: 'A 30 USD application fee needs to be paid in order for the application to be valid and evaluated.' scholarship_exists.quote: International students have the opportunity to receive admission scholarships at Sabancı University. All international applicants who meet the application requirements are automatically considered for a scholarship.
scholarship_exists.how_found: Search (site:sabanciuniv.edu) 'Sabancı University international students scholarship undergraduate admission' -> result 'Scholarships' (iro.sabanciuniv.edu); also main-domain page https://www.sabanciuniv.edu/en/scholarships, heading 'Scholarships for Prospective Undergraduate Students'.
scholarship_exists.notes: The university does not give this award a proprietary brand name; it is referred to as the 'admission scholarship' (page heading: 'Scholarships for International Students at Sabancı University'). Award levels are on the Tuition Fee page: 'We offer scholarships to outstanding candidates who exceed our admission requirements, provided as tuition waivers. Our scholarship options cover various percentages of tuition fees, including 25%, 40%, 50%, 60%, and 75%. Additionally, we provide accommodation scholarships, covering the cost of three- or four-person rooms in our campus dormitories.' No separate application: FAQ 'There is no separate application process for scholarships. All international candidates are automatically evaluated for scholarships during the admission process based on their academic performance.' Duration (FAQ): 'Scholarships are guaranteed to continue for one year in the Foundational Development Year (English Prep Year) and for four years in undergraduate programs'. Coverage (FAQ): 'The scholarship is a tuition waiver scholarship and it only covers tuition fees.' Limited and competitive: 'achieving a certain score does not guarantee a specific scholarship level.' The country-specific state scholarships listed on the same page (Azerbaijan, Iraq, Oman, Libya, Pakistan, Qatar) are government-run, not university-run, and none covers Kazakhstan.

scholarship_international.quote: Yes, Sabancı University offers a range of scholarships for international students based on academic merit.
scholarship_international.how_found: Search (site:sabanciuniv.edu) 'Sabancı University international students scholarship undergraduate admission' -> result 'Tuition Fees and Scholarships' FAQ (iro.sabanciuniv.edu) -> question 'Are there any scholarships available for international students?'.
scholarship_international.notes: The admission scholarship is designed for international (non-Turkish-quota) applicants: the Scholarships page states 'All international applicants who meet the application requirements are automatically considered for a scholarship.' and the main-domain Scholarships page states 'Every international candidate, who applies to Sabanci University, is evaluated for a scholarship automatically when they fulfill the application requirements.' Evaluation criteria (Application Requirements page): 'Scholarship evaluation is made based on applicants’ academic success, extracurricular activities, and scholarship quota.'

access_notes: No blocks, logins, robots restrictions or JavaScript-only content were encountered; every page returned HTTP 200 to plain curl and to the fetch tool.

https://www.sabanciuniv.edu/en/undergraduate-admissions-international-students now 301-redirects to https://iro.sabanciuniv.edu/en/application-requirements (international undergraduate admissions live on the International Relations Office subdomain iro.sabanciuniv.edu, not on an 'admission.sabanciuniv.edu' host).
https://www.sabanciuniv.edu/en/eligibility is about outgoing exchange eligibility for enrolled students, not international admission; it was read and discarded.

The ECTS programme page (ects.sabanciuniv.edu) states the degree awarded and mode of study but not the language of instruction or campus; the IRO programme page was therefore used for item 0 (it states 'All programs are taught in English' / 'The medium of instruction is English.').
The Required Exam/Diploma List page carries no academic-year label; it is the current undated list (an archived 2024-2025 version exists under a separate URL).

Two official pages give different opening dates for the 2026-2027 application window (How to Apply: 'January 1st, 2026'; Application Requirements: 'December 15, 2025'); both give the same closing date, 28 August 2026, 16:00 Turkish time.
No 2027-2028 (autumn 2027) undergraduate international application conditions, deadlines or tuition were published as of 2026-10-17; 2026-2027 values are recorded and flagged in notes.

TOEFL iBT: the university lists both the old 0-120 scale (85) and the new 1-6 band scale (4.5) because ETS changed the scale for tests taken from 21 January 2026; an autumn-2027 applicant testing after that date faces the 4.5 minimum. IELTS is not accepted at all (YÖK decision).
Several quotes join adjacent table cells or consecutive lines from the same page with ' | ' or single spaces; the words themselves are unaltered.
